description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Change the business page’s draft; nothing goes live until publish_page. Either describe the change in the owner’s words (prompt, e.g. "warmer, in blue, and say we're insured"): it waits in line and is written from the published knowledge in a minute or two (read my_page until status is idle), or set fields yourself (page; fields you leave out keep their draft values): headline up to 90 characters, intro up to 400, up to 4 highlights of up to 32, up to 6 sections of {title, body}, cta (the booking button) up to 32, theme one of green, blue, rose, amber, slate, violet, photo an id from my_page photos or null. Everything is plain text, never HTML. Pass exactly one of prompt or page.

prompt.description: The change, in the owner’s words

name: update_page
